question: Can input-conditioned coefficients over a reusable native-product dictionary support jointly faithful output features when a global scalar and a one-product-per-feature encoder do not?
decision: Close M89-M94 geometric/deletion/error-decomposition series. Return to a controlled causal-supervision feasibility comparison, not another local scalar/subset search.

architecture.product_dictionary: All4608 frozen native products h=(Lz)*(Rz); L/R from hash-bound M77 reference
architecture.feature_normalization: Fixed per-product RMS on4092 unique natural training positions only, without centering. For exactly zero RMS use1 and report count. No heldout statistics.
architecture.output_dictionary: Frozen unit-column decoder B of the two existing dense intact_KL M87 starts, seeds71/72; dense chosen structurally to avoid gating confounds, not because of evaluation rank
architecture.prediction: offset + B C (h/RMS); native Down_bias added once externally
architecture.initialization: C0=B_pseudoinverse W diag(RMS), offset=(I-B B_pseudoinverse)c, c=output_mean+output_scale*features.bias. Compute float64 initialization and recordfloat32 replay error. Exact projected-native function in real arithmetic.
architecture.frozen: Native product weights, decoder B, RMS, affine offset and all downstream model weights
architecture.gates: None in this feasibility baseline; no claim of block/shared sparse feature discovery or input-product compression

matched_comparison.matching: Same initialization, product/output dictionaries, schedules,optimizer,budget,data and natural retention; only task causal term differs
matched_comparison.training_data: Existing70 training pairs across11 families and natural docs0-31; whole-task7families and14 source-group pairs remain excluded
matched_comparison.schedule: Reuse exact M60 seed71/72 schedules:66natural plus66task updates, alternating natural first; both endpoints averaged
matched_comparison.optimizer: Fresh Adam lr1e-4 with existing M87 defaults;132updates/final state only. No decoder renormalization because decoder frozen. No warmup or LR/step sweep.
matched_comparison.causal_weight: Training-only calibration before fitting, same declared global mean-K/mean-balanced-B rule as M86 across both starts and fixed schedules; retain fixed M60 family/region denominators. Freeze numeric weight and training receipt after calibration, before fitting.

preflight_deliverable: Hash-bound RMS statistics and both exact-initialization states; independent float64 reconstruction including bias convention.
Input-only guard and native-bypass proof; relative initial projection agreement<=1e-5.
Independent loss arithmetic and finite-difference parameter and endpoint gradients on training cases, using prior established tolerances; explicit identity checks.
Implementation state/optimizer/schedule audit; then calibration and numeric training receipt. No fitting before these pass.
evaluation: After fixed training: natural retention, allwhole-task andsource-group tests, three causal corners and actualbothreplacement, source/final/identity. Compare4 final states againsttheir2 initial full-projection references. Preserveallweak/ineligible cases andeverycandidate; no evaluation tuning.
limits: This is a strong teacher-derived dictionary with more retained products and more trainable coefficients than M87, not a matched-capacity proof that architecture caused earlier failures.
Primary controlled contrast is KL-only versus joint supervision within this architecture. Cross-architecture outcomes are descriptive.
If jointly faithful coefficients are achievable, then test sparse/grouped organization and manifold validity; successful training alone would not establish semantic units.
Failure must be diagnosed from the fixed run, not followed by an automatic optimizer or rank sweep.
